registryName: Hubitat Automation Map App and Integration Registry
designNotes: v0.3 separates application/integration definitions from physical device/driver definitions.
Use the companion Device/Driver Registry for manufacturer/model/protocol/driver enrichment.
v0.2 expands the registry from external dependency enrichment into a catalogue of Hubitat-native automations, apps, integrations and legacy platform apps.
Native Hubitat apps are first-class graph nodes even when they have no external dependency.
hubitatCategory distinguishes APP, AUTOMATION and INTEGRATION as presented by current Hubitat UI.
Built-in app identity and parent/child ownership take precedence over HPM/community heuristics.
Entries marked BUILTIN_SEED_VERIFY_RUNTIME should be verified against the target hub/platform version before being treated as canonical.
Match native Hubitat metadata first, then HPM package metadata, registry rules, heuristics, and finally user overrides.
HPM identification does not by itself establish architecture; dependencies describe the architectural path.
A single integration may have multiple dependencies with different runtime criticality.
Transport values marked LAN_OR_CLOUD or similar require runtime/user refinement.
Do not classify Zigbee/Z-Wave device drivers as external integrations unless they introduce a separate bridge, service, or gateway.

Matching MUST be case-insensitive. Real package naming is inconsistent (BOND vs Bond, Ecowitt vs EcoWitt, kasaDoorbell vs Kasa) and case-sensitive matching produced 17 false negatives against live HPM data.
